name: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_swap < T > (mut left : usize , mut mid : * mut T , mut right : usize)
rule: The range of elements from `mid.sub(left)` (inclusive) to `mid.add(right)` (exclusive) must be valid for reading and writing.
api: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_swap < T > (mut left : usize , mut mid : * mut T , mut right : usize)
